settlement_source: AAA Gas Prices https://gasprices.aaa.com/ national Regular average 'Price as of <date>' (AAA derives from OPIS; OPIS not named).
settlement_variable: AAA US national average regular price labeled 'Price as of D' for market dated D; YES iff strictly greater than strike. Page shows FOUR decimals (e.g. $4.2858) and Kalshi uses that string verbatim. Verified Oct 26 (4.2858), Oct 25 (4.2892), Oct 19 (4.2953 via Wayback).
timezone: ET; close_time 03:59Z = 23:59 EDT the evening before D; DST behaviour unknown.
tie_handling: Strictly greater; exact ties possible (4-dp values vs 4-dp strikes) -> NO.
rounding: None; 4-dp page value; strikes at $0.005 steps.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Trading closes 23:59 ET before D; AAA posts D's value overnight between ~00:42 and ~05:56 ET (Wayback-bounded); Kalshi settles automatically 07:06-07:14 ET on D (35/36 days). NO pre-close verifier window from AAA itself.
early_close_or_void_clauses: No void: no data -> last available day's value (known at close -> fully predictable if AAA misses an update); revisions after expiration ignored; Market Outcome Review 6.3(d); latest expiration one month after.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Series 'US gas price up' / event 'US gas prices tomorrow' imply direction; markets are level thresholds
PDF expiration 10:15/11:00/15:00 ET vs actual ~07:10 ET; Last Trading 11:59 PM ET matches 03:59Z only under EDT
